proposal.summary: Proposal only, not an accepted policy decision. Practice and Evaluation modes are asked to operate within the exact same server world identity and topology, and a mid-shift mode transition is to be refused during an active shift so that trajectory integrity, unannounced incident progression and scoring isolation survive. Any training mode switch would require a clean shift restart with a verified roster.

rules.rule: Both Practice and Evaluation modes consume the existing FoundationTrainingMode enum, FoundationSimulationProfile.TrainingMode, and the FoundationWorldSimulation.TrainingMode getter without duplicating enums or creating separate world branches.
In Practice mode, requested guidance responses include the synthetic procedure hint, recommended action and evidence basis tag.
In Evaluation mode, procedure hint fields and step-by-step guidance are strictly excluded from client projections and responses.
Both modes project the same server world identity (WorldId, ShiftId, 13 regions, 12 portals) and differ only in the mode response filtering.

A mid-shift mode transition is refused while the shift is live: the call returns false with the documented blocked reason and does not auto-restart, clear or otherwise mutate the active simulation. A request for the mode already running is an idempotent no-op.
Adding the mode to a projection must not delete the authored geometry status, which the current-location banner and the route synthetic label consume.

blockedReason: Mid-shift mode transition is blocked without an accepted PM policy decision (FMP-11b-D01). Active shift trajectory and scoring fairness require a clean shift restart.
